easyPrerequisites:
"Human" or "Artificer" chosen with Roaming Throne.
Deadeye Navigator paired with Urza.
description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers once.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve both Urza triggers, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
